detail: Decompiled onOpen only classifies connections by handshake resource descriptor (PC9090/PC9091/PC8888/APP8888/ALL8888) and stores them in webSocketMap; no token, origin or credential check present in the method body.

onWriteFile passes client-supplied FileBean.fileName and jsonData straight to MapFileUtils.writeFile(SD_BASE_FOLDER+DIR_MAP_SOURCES, fileName, data). writeFile builds paths by string concatenation (str+str2 / new File(str,str2)), deletes any existing file, then writes; no canonicalisation or '..' filtering in the decompiled bodies. Reachability from outside the app (RIA-001) and process privileges at runtime remain UNVERIFIED (no live testing performed).
